title: Stack manifest
description: One adopter's pin of the certified release train. The adopter keeps this file; the train keeps the certified versions.

release_train.description: The train this manifest pins. Must equal the train's release_train.

source.description: A resolvable reference to the train's stack-releases.json (URL or repository-relative path).

pins.description: One entry per certified component the adopter consumes, keyed by component name. An empty entry follows the train. A copied version or commit must equal the train.
